coordinator.basis: Coordinator process intervals include its tool calls; host waits may overlap worker inference and native execution.

timing.model_timing_basis: From context-view journaling to response journaling, including request preparation and validation; not provider-only latency or time to first token.
timing.overlap_policy: Only process-and-workers plus combined verification partition total elapsed time. All other fields are nested or overlapping and must not be added to that total.

routing.basis: Sum of recorded classifier request durations; overlaps delegation and worker activity.

adapter.basis: Task spans end at the last journal event, not an independently observed process exit. Empty lanes mean no specialist task was submitted.

physics.basis: Task spans end at the last journal event, not an independently observed process exit. Empty lanes mean no specialist task was submitted.

publication.basis: Task spans end at the last journal event, not an independently observed process exit. Empty lanes mean no specialist task was submitted.

sequence_overhead.scope: Includes frozen-input audits, bookkeeping and transitions between measured arms. Initial prelaunch audits, preparation and calibration are outside this sequence span. Per-arm task timers start at coordinator launch.

comparison.interpretation: Equal verified completion; compare median total latency and conservatively priced model usage.

following_arm_overhead_sensitivity.basis: Assign each observed transition gap to the following arm; first arm has zero preceding gap. Initial audits remain excluded. This is bookkeeping sensitivity, not a separately clocked task measurement.

astra_tariff_applicability.note: A fresh turn with complete aggregate input and output usage totaling less than 272000 bounds every included request below the threshold. Otherwise retain both rates unless request-level proof exists. Confirm actual service tier before estimating; priority, batch and flex multipliers are not applied here.

price_snapshot.description: Published standard API-equivalent rates; not an invoice. Both Astra context tariffs retained unless per-request evidence proves short context. Full ToFa input tariff without an assumed cache discount. All routing/generation/recovery attempts included.

protocol.cost: All measured Astra delegation, work and recovery calls; all ToFa classifier, worker, rejected and fallback responses. Missing usage stays unknown. Cached subsets are not double counted. Setup response uncertainty is retained separately.
excluded: CPU hosting, storage and network charges
protocol.primary_comparison: Equal or higher verified completion, lower median end-to-end elapsed time, and lower median total model API-equivalent cost. Report all pairs and worst-case pricing uncertainty; no failed or expensive arm is discarded.
protocol.quality: All three final-source regression and native checks pass; merged patches pass the same regressions and an independent six-case simulation/export/replay/native-reader check.
protocol.timing: From coordinator process launch through worker shutdown and combined-patch verification. Includes repair attempts, model calls, simulation, conversion and independent verification.

retained_initial_validation.reason: Concurrent TaskStore initialization could fail with SQLITE_BUSY during the transition to WAL journal mode. Initialization is now serialized; normal journal connections do not repeat that transition.

startup_race_regression.after_fix_outcome: Observation-recovery tests, including thread and process initialization, passed on the repaired Linux runtime.
startup_race_regression.before_fix_outcome: New four-process test reproduced SQLITE_BUSY on the prior implementation.

whole_experiment_model_cost.basis: All declared arms, including baseline and hybrid; standard API equivalents.
